description: Where a ride request stands: waiting for the customer's email confirmation (or confirmation_expired when the Confirm link ran out), waiting for Feminiq Rides to confirm, payment request sent (with the payment link), confirmed, completed or cancelled. Also returns the ride (car, passengers, luggage, route or tours, addresses, payment choice, flight) so a change can be quoted again. Needs the bookingId from request_booking and the customer's email.

email.description: The customer's email address used for the booking (proves it is their booking).
